# AAA International Seafood

> Wholesale seafood purveyor in Vernon, California (Los Angeles area), supplying restaurants, chefs, sushi bars, fine-dining kitchens, hotels, caterers and foodservice operators across Southern California since 2007. AAA only sells sushi-grade seafood, fresh and frozen. Its fresh Bluefin, Yellowfin and Albacore tuna are #1 grade.

- Business name: AAA International Seafood (AAA International Seafood Corp.)
- Address: 2535 E 28th Street, Vernon, CA 90058
- Phone: (323) 582-8003
- Website: https://www.aaainternationalseafood.com/
- Customers: restaurants, sushi bars, fine-dining kitchens, hotels, caterers and foodservice operators
- Pricing: quoted per order by product and quantity, because seafood prices follow the market
- New customers: send a message through the contact page; the sales team replies within 24 business hours
- Volume: pallet orders are available

## Products

- [Fresh Bluefin Tuna](https://www.aaainternationalseafood.com/bluefin-tuna): #1 grade, from Mexico and Spain, whole loins. Frozen Bluefin loins, saku and ground tuna under the AAA Branded Frozen Tuna label.
- [Fresh Yellowfin Tuna](https://www.aaainternationalseafood.com/yellowfin-tuna): #1 grade, whole loins. Frozen Yellowfin saku and ground tuna.
- [Fresh Albacore Tuna](https://www.aaainternationalseafood.com/albacore-tuna): #1 grade, whole loins. Frozen Albacore loins.
- [Fresh Fish](https://www.aaainternationalseafood.com/fresh-fish): Salmon and King Salmon (Faroe Islands, Scotland, Norway, Canada, New Zealand and more), Branzino, Striped Bass, Madai (Red Sea Bream), Kanpachi (Amberjack), Shima Aji (Striped Jack), Kinmedai (Golden Eye Snapper), Hirame (Flounder), New Zealand Tai (Snapper), Kurodai (Black Sea Bream), Aji (Horse Mackerel). Availability changes with the season and the market.
- [Uni (Sea Urchin)](https://www.aaainternationalseafood.com/uni): from Santa Barbara, California and from Japan (Bafun Uni).
- [Frozen Seafood](https://www.aaainternationalseafood.com/frozen-seafood): Frozen Hamachi (Yellowtail), Tuna Cube, Escolar Saku.
- [All products](https://www.aaainternationalseafood.com/products): more than 100 products stocked.

## Delivery

- [Delivery areas](https://www.aaainternationalseafood.com/delivery): routes run from Santa Barbara and Bakersfield down through Los Angeles, Orange County, the Inland Empire, Palm Springs and San Diego County. Areas served include Bakersfield, Palmdale / Lancaster, Santa Barbara, Victorville / Hesperia, Riverside, Palm Springs / Palm Desert / Indio, Temecula / Murrieta / Menifee and San Diego County. Delivery days and minimums are confirmed by the sales team for each area.
- Orders are handled under HACCP-aligned, cold-chain protocols from the dock to the customer's door.
